newsitem.title: IRAN: Test production starts at Iranian iron ore mine.
newsitem.headline: Test production starts at Iranian iron ore mine.

text.p: Test production has started at an iron ore mine built for $600 million in central Iran, a newspaper said on Thursday.
The daily Jomhuri Eslami said the Chadormalou mine in Yazd province, with a yearly capacity of 5 million tonnes, began production on Tuesday.

Iran's Mines and Metals Minister Mohammad Hossein Mahlouji, quoted by the newspaper, said the mine was built in three years for $600 million by Iranian contractors and companies from Japan, Sweden and Germany. He did not give further details.
The mine will be commissioned early in the new Iranian year that starts on March 21, Mahlouji said.
Steel production will reach 6 million tonnes in the current year, up from 4.3 million tonnes last year, he added.
